svg.title: The CI gates map
svg.desc: On every pull request: web-ci (python, frontend, api-image), scripture-integrity (integrity), version-consistency (versions), security (secrets, static-analysis, deps), pr-hygiene (title), e2e (playwright) and deploy-docs (docs). The integration ruleset requires python, frontend, integrity, secrets and docs; the main ruleset adds versions and static-analysis, strictly. Merges into integration run deploy-staging; merges into main run deploy-production, which waits for the required checks plus playwright on the exact commit. Between merges: the data canary every six hours, uptime every fifteen minutes, the docs job every night, a weekly full-history secret scan and a weekly external-link check.

text.font-family: "Source Serif 4", Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif
